stages.name: Round 4 RAGAS scoring
stages.resume_history: The first process and two safe resume attempts stopped on three HTTP 402 responses from the original key. After a new .env key was verified, the final resume used 20 chat requests: all three missing q011 scores were appended while the original 47 fingerprinted scores were skipped. Across scoring, seven temporary HTTP 503 responses were retried within the cap.

stages.name: new key verification
stages.detail: The effective Settings key matched .env with no process-environment override. Two bounded generation probes timed out without an HTTP response; a no-generation model metadata request returned HTTP 200 and the formal resume then returned successful generation responses. No key value was logged.
